bosses.name: Mano
bosses.where: Thicket Around the Beach III (Victoria Road, near Lith Harbor)
bosses.tryAt: Lv 20+ solo, or a duo at 15+
bosses.tip: Everyone's first boss. It barely moves, so ranged classes can kite it along the floor. Its touch still hits 280 to 380, so carry potions if you're under 25.

bosses.name: King Slime
bosses.where: Kerning City Party Quest, last stage
bosses.tip: Resists every element, so physical attackers do the heavy lifting. It slams the ground: jump just before it lands and the shockwave passes under you. Full run in the KPQ guide.

bosses.name: Mushmom
bosses.where: Someone Else's House (hidden street, Henesys area)
bosses.tryAt: Lv 40+ with a stack of potions, or a party at 35
bosses.tip: The money boss. Players report Ilbi Throwing-Stars dropping, which every Thief wants. Fire Wizards hit its weakness. Killing it is also a step in Maya's lv 47 citizenship chain.

bosses.name: Shade
bosses.tip: Not a meso farm, but the lv 47 citizenship chain A Grudge That Won't Rest (Chun Ji) has you kill 50 Wraiths and then Shade, for about 50,000 EXP.

bosses.name: Zombie Mushmom
bosses.where: The Grave of Mushmom (dungeon past the Ant Tunnel)
bosses.tip: Touch damage runs 770 to 1,045, so bring HP potions and a party. It's holy-weak, so a Cleric pulls their weight here. Another source of Ilbis.

bosses.name: Rotten Mushmom
bosses.where: Someone Else's Grave (Forgotten Hollow, off Decayed Tunnel I)
bosses.tip: A brand-new boss made for Classic, living in the Forgotten Hollow zone that opens on Nov 18. Weak to both holy and fire, and poison barely tickles it.

bosses.name: Jr. Balrog
bosses.where: The Cursed Sanctuary (past Sanctuary Entrance IV, Sleepywood)
bosses.tryAt: A strong party at 70+ with the accuracy to hit it
bosses.maybe: Old pre-Big Bang drop tables also list 60% weapon attack scrolls and level 60 to 70 weapons. Not confirmed in Classic yet.
bosses.tip: The final boss of Victoria Island. You need about 157 accuracy at level 80 (219 at level 70) to hit it reliably. Mystic Door and Teleport Rock don't work in its room, so walk in stocked up.

bossFaq: What is the easiest boss in MapleStory Classic?
Mano, the giant snail near Lith Harbor. It's level 20, moves slowly and stays on its floor, so most classes can solo it around level 20.
How long is the boss respawn timer?
Most bosses store a 1-hour timer in the map data, but players report closer to 90 minutes, so plan for 1 to 1.5 hours. Jr. Balrog is about 3 hours. King Slime only appears inside KPQ.
Players have reported Ilbis from Mushmom and Zombie Mushmom. They're one of the most valuable drops for Thieves.
Is Crimson Balrog in MapleStory Classic?
Not at launch. It attacks the boat to Orbis, and Ossyria isn't in Classic yet.
What level should I fight Jr. Balrog?
It's level 80 with 325,400 HP and needs about 157 accuracy at level 80. Bring a strong party at 70 or above, and check your accuracy first.

kpq.start: Form a party of 4, then the leader talks to Lakelis by the sewer entrance in Kerning City. Grab the one-time quest Proof of Companionship from Lakelis first: killing King Slime once pays 1,870 EXP, 687 mesos, 1 fame and a random 60% earring stat scroll.

stages.title: Coupons for Cloto
stages.text: 22 Ligators (68 EXP each) drop coupons. Cloto asks every member except the leader a question, and each answers by handing over that many coupons for a Pass. Drop extra coupons; only the exact number counts.
stages.tip: If someone draws the 35-coupon question, make them the leader: the leader never gets asked, and the old leader draws a fresh, probably cheaper question.

stages.title: The ropes
stages.text: Four ropes: A and B on the high branch, C and D on the low ones. Three members hang on three ropes, the leader checks with Cloto, and you work through the 4 possible combinations.

stages.title: The kittens
stages.text: Five platforms carrying 1 to 5 kittens. Three members stand on three of them. There are 10 combinations, and the commonly shared list forgets 3‑4‑5.

stages.title: The barrels
stages.text: Six numbered barrels stacked 1, 2-3, 4-5-6. Three members stand on three of them. 20 combinations, so split up who calls them out.

stages.title: King Slime
stages.text: Curse Eyes up top, Jr. Neckis in the middle, King Slime at the bottom. All ten drop a coupon, and the leader hands all ten to Cloto. Jr. Neckis dodge a lot, so bring at least one player with good accuracy.
stages.tip: King Slime resists every element and splits into 11 Slimes. Jump just before it lands to dodge the ground slam.

stages.title: Bonus room
stages.text: 36 Horny and Green Mushrooms in one tiny map, the densest in the quest. Clear it, then talk to Nella to leave. She stands on every KPQ map.

cloto: DEX a Bowman or Thief needs
kpq.clotoNote: Questions can change. Players have also seen 21 and 30, so more questions exist.
kpq.shoes: Level 28, any class, +1 to all four stats, 18 weapon defense, 7 magic defense, 5 upgrade slots, tradeable.
rules: Party chat: type J>PQ with your level and class to join, or L>PQ / R>PQ if you're building one.
Done with your coupons? Help whoever is slowest.
Say so before you go AFK, and don't leave or kick mid-run.
Explain the combos calmly to first-timers. You were one once.
kpq.death: Dying no longer ends the run. Three players can still finish: stage 1 needs two passes instead of three, and the leader fills the empty spot on the puzzles. Drop to two before the puzzles are done and you'll need to rebuild.
other: Limited event, mid-November to early December 2026.
Arrives Dec 9, 2026. Details not published yet.
Not in Classic at launch: their regions aren't live.
faq: What level do you need for KPQ in MapleStory Classic?
Level 21, with no upper cap. The original game capped it at 30.
No. You need a party of exactly 4 to enter, though 3 can finish if someone drops mid-run.
10 for a job advancement level, 15 for the EXP from level 1 to 2, 20 for a Magician's INT, 25 for a Bowman or Thief's DEX, and 35 for a Warrior's STR.
Squishy Shoes (level 28, +1 all stats, 5 slots) and a Pass. Everyone also gets a Companion's Magic Box at the end.

quests.name: Maple Island quests (all 10)
quests.task: Talk to every NPC on the island: Pio's recycled boxes, Rain's 7-part quiz, Mai's training and more.
quests.note: Missable: the boat off the island is one-way. The Green Relaxer chair only comes from here.

quests.name: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request
quests.task: Pay Nella 1,000 mesos to start, then run errands around Kerning.

quests.name: Maple World's Unique Fun: Omok
quests.task: Collect Omok tables and pieces from monster drops.
quests.note: Low EXP, but you get to play Omok with your party.

quests.name: Welcome to the Free Market!
quests.task: A short tour of the Free Market.
quests.note: Quick and easy Blue Potions.

quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry
quests.task: Collect drops around Henesys.

quests.name: Dr. Betty's Research on Plants
quests.task: Gather plant samples, leaves and firewood.

quests.name: Alex the Runaway Kid
quests.task: Hunt Green and Blue Mushrooms, then find Alex's old watch.
quests.note: Weighted Earrings sold for about 7,500 mesos in launch week.

quests.name: Jane and the Mushroom
quests.task: Kill 30 Blue and 30 Horny Mushrooms and bring their caps.
quests.note: 60% scrolls rose about 5x in price in launch week. Sell it or use it.

quests.name: Maya and the Weird Medicine
quests.task: A 7-step chain: Zombie Mushrooms, Octopus legs, leaves and a trip for medicine.
quests.note: The best EXP-per-effort chain in the early 20s.

quests.name: Proof of Companionship
quests.task: Kill King Slime once in KPQ.
quests.note: Pick it up before your first KPQ run.

quests.name: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request
quests.task: Hunt Jr. Neckis, Horny Mushrooms and Evil Eyes; bring feathers and leather.

quests.name: Mystery of Niora Hospital
quests.task: Hunt Stirges for mirror glass, then Zombie Mushrooms.
quests.note: Capes aren't sold in NPC shops. This is an easy first one.

quests.name: Camila's Gem
quests.task: A one-step gem delivery.

quests.name: "In My Own Right!" crafting quests
quests.task: One per profession: show your mentor you can craft. Numbers are per quest.
quests.note: Pairs with our crafting guide.

quests.name: Caretaker's Ledger
quests.task: Collect torn ledger pages and piece the ledger back together.
quests.note: Huge EXP for level 28 and a pile of potions.

quests.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
quests.task: Bring Arwen's Glass Shoe (Fire Boars drop it).
quests.note: Repeatable, so it doubles as a steady meso source.

quests.name: Collecting For Maya
quests.task: Turn in 20 each of common mushroom caps and drops.
quests.note: Uses drops you'd otherwise vendor.

quests.name: Icarus's Dream
quests.task: Bring Processed Wood, Stirge Wings, feathers and tablecloths.

quests.name: Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book
quests.task: A 9-step chain: Lupins, Curse Eyes, an Unagi special, a Diamond and more.
quests.note: The biggest EXP chain in your early 30s.

quests.name: What Shumi Lost
quests.task: Find Shumi's coin, roll of cash and sack of cash in the Construction Site.
quests.note: One of the best meso quests in the game.

quests.name: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.task: Kill 570 Zombie Lupins and hand in 570 Cursed Dolls across five steps.
quests.note: Only worth it if you're grinding Zombie Lupins anyway. Players call it a grind trap.

quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach
quests.task: Bring coconuts, Lupin bananas and Lorang and Clang claws.
quests.note: The single biggest meso payout among regular quests.

quests.name: Shadow of the World Tree
quests.task: Collect magical resonance and rotten root fragments.

quests.name: The Road Home
quests.task: Find Zelya's map fragments, then hunt Raffles.
quests.note: Forgotten Hollow opens Nov 18.

quests.name: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
quests.task: Kill 50 of six different monsters across Victoria and bring their drops.
quests.note: Pairs with Cold Eye training around level 41.

quests.name: Pia's Present For a Friend
quests.task: Bring Silver Ingots, Dragon Skins, Screws and a Black Crystal.
quests.note: Costly in materials. Easier if you craft.

quests.name: Jane the Alchemist
quests.task: Hunt Copper Drakes, Wraiths and Maladies for alchemy ingredients.

quests.name: Echoes of the Abyss
quests.task: Rafflesia petals, a scorched scroll and 50 Echopus.
quests.note: Forgotten Hollow opens Nov 18.

quests.name: Icarus and the Flying Medicine
quests.task: Collect 50 weird-vibes medicine and 20 witchgrass leaves.

quests.name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
quests.task: Bring a Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, Screws, Drake Skulls and Dragon Skins.
quests.note: Expensive materials for the EXP.

quests.name: Another of Maya's Collections
quests.task: Bring 30 each of mid-level drops, then golem rubble and a Diamond.

quests.name: The Alligators at the Swamp
quests.task: Hunt Jr. Neckis and Ligators, then 120 Crocos.

quests.name: Building a New House For Blackbull
quests.task: Bring 100 Stone Golem Rubble, 30 Screws and 30 Processed Wood.

quests.name: Manji's Old Gladius
quests.task: Restore an old sword with a Star Rock, Piece of Ice, Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather.

quests.name: A Fragile Sanctuary
quests.task: Cursed Dolls and Duskmander Tails.
quests.note: Forgotten Hollow opens Nov 18.

quests.name: Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
quests.task: Find the Double-Rooted Red Ginseng in the Forest of Patience jump quest.
quests.note: Jump quest. See our secrets page for the route.

quests.name: John's Present
quests.task: Climb the Deep Forest of Patience jump quest for Pink, Blue and White Violas.
quests.note: The biggest one-time EXP quest for the 60s.

citizen.intro: At level 12 you can become a citizen of Henesys or Kerning City. Citizenship quests are some of the best EXP in the game, and every grade knocks 5 to 25% off shops and taxis in your town (up to 50% off storage).
rows: About 19,900 EXP and 3,500 mesos per town
Four quick talk-to quests on your town's Community Board.
17 to 18 steps, each asking for 30 of a common drop (snail shells, caps, ribbons, tails). Hoard them while you level.
A Marble of Friendship / The Doctor Who Never Returned
Includes a Mushmom kill and 50 Drake Skulls.
A Grudge That Won't Rest (Chun Ji)
A Task / A Gift for a Citizen of Honor

questFaq: What are the best quests in MapleStory Classic?

For EXP: Maya and the Weird Medicine (21), Caretaker's Ledger (28), Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book (32), Ronnie's fairy house chain (41) and John's Present (65), plus the citizenship donation chains from level 12. For mesos: Special Taste of Florina Beach and What Shumi Lost.
Every Maple Island quest. The boat to Lith Harbor is one-way, so hand them all in before you leave.
Are quests worth it in Classic?
Yes. Many give more than a full level at the level you can start them, plus potions you'd otherwise buy.
When can I join a citizenship?
Level 12, in Henesys or Kerning City. The donation chains reward common drops you'd normally vendor.

money.marketNote: Median sold prices on the Free Market, Founder's Access launch week (Oct 13, 2026). Prices move fast after Grand Launch, so check before you sell.
money.trendTip: Sell ores and monster drops early while crafters are paying. Hold, farm or use your 60% scrolls. Don't overpay for level 31 to 50 gear: its prices are falling.

stages.title: Don't vendor the wrong stuff
items: Sell ores, Leather and Animal Fur Bundles to players, not NPCs. Every crafter needs them.
Vendor duplicate early weapons: they sell back for more than most drops (table below).
Do Alex the Runaway Kid (lv 18) for a shot at Weighted Earrings, worth about 7,500 mesos.

stages.title: Quests and 60% scrolls
items: Jane and the Mushroom (lv 20) gives a random 60% weapon scroll. These were the hottest items of launch week.
What Shumi Lost (lv 35) pays 12,222 mesos plus 30 Mana Elixirs.
Special Taste of Florina Beach (lv 37) pays 15,210 mesos, the most of any regular quest.
Green Mushrooms are reported to drop Claw Attack scrolls.

stages.title: Bosses and crafting
items: Mushmom drops 1,800 to 2,200 mesos per kill, plus a shot at Ilbi Throwing-Stars.
Zombie Mushmom drops 1,150 to 1,405 mesos per kill.
Craft for profit: Iron Knuckle (about +1,500 per craft), arrow bundles (+900 to +1,200), Black Crystal (+800), Hardwood Wand (+710).

merch: Track sold prices, not asking prices.
Stick to things that sell fast: attack scrolls, glove scrolls, throwing stars, Weighted Earrings, Pure Water and Salad.
Prices on new drops tend to fall after launch. Dump early instead of holding.
Cash Shop outfits sell for mesos: about 8 mesos per NX in launch week (a 3,500 NX outfit was roughly 28,000 mesos).
dont: Don't buy mesos from sellers. It breaks Nexon's rules and can get your account banned.
Don't vendor 60% scrolls or ores to NPCs.
Don't start Rowen's Cursed Doll chain for money. It's a long grind for 5,700 mesos.
faq: What is the best way to make mesos early in MapleStory Classic?
Sell ores, Leather and fur to crafters on the Free Market, vendor duplicate early weapons, and do the meso-heavy quests: What Shumi Lost and Special Taste of Florina Beach.
What sells best on the Free Market?
In launch week: Iron Ore, Bronze Ore, Leather, Mithril Ore, Selective 5-slot Coupons, Weighted Earrings and 60% attack scrolls.
Which boss drops the most mesos?
Of the reported bosses, Mushmom: about 1,800 to 2,200 mesos per kill, plus a chance at Ilbi Throwing-Stars.
Can you sell NX items for mesos?
Yes. Cash Shop outfits and Selective 5-slot Coupons trade on the Free Market, at roughly 8 mesos per NX in launch week.
